label: Bible Study
prompt: For the LORD God is a sun and _____: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
verse: For the LORD God is a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good thing will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
note: From the pilgrims' psalm that prefers a day in God's courts to a thousand anywhere else.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: _____ the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
verse: And I looked, and rose up, and said unto the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, Be not ye afraid of them: remember the Lord, which is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses.
note: With enemies threatening the wall, Nehemiah's rally cry: remember the Lord, and fight for your families.

label: Sunday School
prompt: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did _____ Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
verse: So they ran both together: and the other disciple did outrun Peter, and came first to the sepulchre.
note: On Easter morning two disciples raced to the tomb, and John's Gospel records that the other disciple won.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And hope maketh not _____; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verse: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
note: The end of Paul's chain from tribulation to hope: this hope won't embarrass you, because God's love is already poured in.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a _____ of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
verse: And it shall come to pass, while my glory passeth by, that I will put thee in a clift of the rock, and will cover thee with my hand while I pass by:
note: Moses was tucked into 'a clift of the rock' while God's glory passed by — the KJV's old spelling of cleft.
